Trace, implement and test: 面试题26. 树的子结构

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(NULL), right(NULL) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    bool isSubStructure(TreeNode* A, TreeNode* B) {
        if (!A || !B) {
            return false;
        }
        return dfs(A, B) || isSubStructure(A->left, B) || isSubStructure(A->right, B);
    }

    bool dfs(TreeNode* A, TreeNode* B) {
        if (!B) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!A || A->val != B->val) {
            return false;
        }
        return dfs(A->left, B->left) && dfs(A->right, B->right);
    }
};
